newsitem.title: UK: BZW appoints new global head of sales and research.
newsitem.headline: BZW appoints new global head of sales and research.

text.p: BZW said on Thursday it had appointed Neil Cummins as a managing director and global head of sales and research in its global markets division.
Cummins, 42, joins BZW from Morgan Stanley in London where he was a managing director with joint responsibility for fixed income distribution in Europe, BZW said.
"This is a critically important appointment in the development of our global markets capability," said Bob Diamond, chief executive of the global markets division.

"With more than a decade's experience in the European capital markets, Neil is exactly the right person to spearhead our global distribution effort and continue the development of a world class research operation," Diamond said in a statement.
